speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The town. Two pounds. Write it where I can see the line, before either of us calls it given.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Set them on the board, then. I do not write a gift I have not seen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two pounds. Count them as I counted yours. They are for the collection, and for nothing else on this table.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I have counted two. I am writing the line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read it back. I asked to see it written, not to hear that it had been.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Two pounds, of you, to the brief. There is the line. The ink is yours to look at.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have looked. The town has it. That is the gift.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I may be bold with you as with a friend. It is not for myself, Will, it is for the town.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have just written the town's line. Say the next sentence as itself.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: My own London charges have run long. Ten pound till Lady Day would mend them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten pound, to you, till Lady Day.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: To mend the charges. I am not asking you to buy the town a second time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll give two to the town, Richard, and lend nothing to the man, and we'll still be friends at Lady Day.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Then I take it as a man who has heard that answer before. I drink your health.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Drink it. I am not drinking a loan I have refused.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I will not ask the ten again at this table. Once is the supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is the supper. One pound remains. That is the account, and it is not a quarrel.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: One pound. I will not call the owing a slight, and I will not pay it tonight to make the walk feel clean.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not pay it tonight. The one pound stands. We are still friends past it, which is what I said.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: It stands. God keep you, good countryman. It was not a long supper I asked on Saturday, and it has not become one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. You have stood the wine. Do not walk me to the door with a second ask.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: There is no second ask in my mouth. The health is drunk. The line is written.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are friends past the refusal. I am not offering a softer sentence than the one I gave you.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Friends at Lady Day, as you have it. I am not revising your sentence to make mine kinder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. I have a few lines to write before I go, and they are not for this table to hear.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Write them. I will not look over the leaf. A refused man can still leave a friend his paper.
